notes.source: Baselined from an actual deterministic run of the stubbed suite on 2026-09-17: completion_rate=1.0, strategy_accuracy=1.0, keyword_hit_rate=0.7267 over all 30 benchmark queries against eval/corpus (bit-identical across repeated runs).
notes.margin: keyword_hit_rate gate sits 0.0267 under the measured baseline; completion_rate and strategy_accuracy are gated at the measured 1.0 because a dropped query or misrouted strategy is always a regression.
notes.hermetic_mode: The gate runs the real graph with every model seam stubbed (classification, generation, RAGAS critic, embeddings, vector store, reranker, cache) so results are identical with or without PostgreSQL/Redis. Vector-only (ABSTRACT) queries retrieve nothing in this mode, which the keyword baseline reflects; BM25 and hybrid routing, fusion, rerank fallback, the correction loop, and finalize all stay live.
notes.real_ragas: Real RAGAS with a live critic runs nightly via the scheduled workflow (never as a PR gate).
